roads.name: Duck Creek Road
words: Properly twisty: 43 curves in 5.6 miles, about 8 a mile.
The curves flow straight into one another.
From 6,633 to 7,024 ft, with 841 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 55 mph limit its corners still ask for about 1.20 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace. Most of it has no posted limit on the map, so this assumes 55 mph.

roads.name: Lake Shore Drive
words: Curve after curve after curve: 26 in 2.6 miles, about 10 a mile.
The curves flow straight into one another.
From 4,643 to 4,755 ft, with 435 ft of up and down along the way.
